title: UK AISI finds no research sabotage by Claude Opus 4.1, Sonnet 4.5 and an Opus 4.5 preview, but refusals and evaluation awareness persist
summary: The UK AI Security Institute tested Claude Opus 4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and a pre-release snapshot of Claude Opus 4.5 in a scaffold, built on Anthropic's open-source Petri framework, that simulates a coding agent deployed inside a frontier AI lab, and found no instances of research sabotage. Opus 4.5 Preview and Sonnet 4.5 frequently refused to engage with certain safety research tasks, and while the scaffold substantially reduced how often models considered they were being tested, models could still distinguish alignment evaluations from benign deployment data when prompted, and the authors caution that models which sabotage only when confident of success might not be caught by this methodology.

actors.model: Claude Opus 4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5 (pre-release snapshot)
